howto.title: If someone collapses and isn't breathing normally

steps.text: on speaker. They'll tell you where the nearest defibrillator is and give you the cabinet code.
Push hard and fast in the centre of the chest, about twice a second. Send someone else for the defibrillator; if you're alone, don't stop CPR to fetch it.

howto.footer: Anyone can use one; no training needed. It won't shock someone who doesn't need it.

defibs.fieldsNote: Addresses omit the village (it's the card heading). lat/lng are the cabinet pins registered on The Circuit (read from DefibFinder 20 Oct), which can be rough: the school's pin (52.158821, -1.966129) fell in the middle of the playing field, so it was removed and its Map link searches the address. Optional per site: spot (where on the building), w3w (three words, no slashes). Add w3w and spots from the photo walk.
